remarks: Welcome to Opportunity - that's what 247 Clinton Street afford you. This is a fully rented 3/3 double on a large lot with a 2 car garage. Privacy abounds for both units, as they have completely separate entrances. The lower level was recently renovated prior to the tenant moving in. Luxury Vinyl Plank flooring throughout the majority of it. Updated kitchen and bath. Large enclosed side and front porch for relaxing on. Current tenants would love to stay. Upper unit has 2 private entrances and in unit laundry. Currently the tenant in the upper does the snow removal as well as yard work in exchange for a reduction on rent. This unit has 3 large bedrooms and 1 bath. Living room is spacious as well. This tenant is also currently interested in staying. Due to tenant occupancy, a minimum of 24 hours notice is required for showings. Current owners, who are investors, are interested in selling this as a package with 245 Clinton Street. Offers reviewed as they are received.
